content.definition: Kinematics is the study of motion without considering the forces causing the motion.
content.learning_goal: Understand how objects move and represent motion using equations and graphs.

content.definition: Forces describe interactions that change the motion of objects.
content.learning_goal: Apply force models to solve mechanics problems.

content.definition: Energy is the ability of a system to do work.
content.learning_goal: Analyse energy transfers in physical systems.

content.definition: Waves transfer energy without transferring matter permanently.
content.learning_goal: Use wave equations and explain wave phenomena.

content.definition: A field is a region where an object experiences a force.
content.learning_goal: Understand how fields influence objects at a distance.
